$comment: Average drops per run for the planner's run, resin and day estimates, from the Genshin Impact Wiki only (genshin-impact.fandom.com). Every section cites entries in `sources` (page, revision, date read). A value the wiki doesn't give is left out: the planner then shows no estimate for it. Domain AR brackets, resin per domain/ley line run and domain mora come from the game data, not from here. See README.md in this folder before editing.

mastery.note: Talent book averages per domain level I-IV (Avg. columns). Shown on every Domain of Mastery page, e.g. Forsaken Rift. Ranges sourced by the wiki from the Genshin Data Gathering team.

forgery.note: Weapon material averages per domain level I-IV (Avg. columns). Shown on every Domain of Forgery page, e.g. Cecilia Garden.

lootDistribution.note: Community-derived. Its '2-Star Roll' means per domain level are what the in-game reward preview shows (firstRoll below; the build compares them with the game data). Its overall tables repeat the templates' averages.

worldBossRewards.note: Normal boss: boss material per World Level ('1 + 61.85%' = 1.6185 on average) and Ascension Gems (Avg. columns) for WL 0-8. Weekly branch (Andrius): talent material per World Level. WL 9 is not in the table.

normalBoss.note: "players can use Original Resin x40 to open them to claim their rewards".

weeklyBoss.note: "Original Resin x30 to claim the rewards from the first three weekly bosses of their choice, and then Original Resin x60 subsequently"; rewards and discounts reset weekly; "a fixed 33% chance to drop a Dream Solvent".

weeklyBossRewards.note: Talent material per boss level: 70 -> 1, 80 -> '1 + 55%', 90 -> '2 + 10%'; Dream Solvent 33% at every level. No talent material below level 70.

dreamSolvent.note: "Claim Trounce Blossom from Weekly Bosses with Original Resin for a 33% chance to drop."

leyLineOutcrop.note: Rewards and Scaling: 'Average Character EXP' (the middle of each book range) and Mora per World Level; WL 6-9 share one row.

byWorldLevel.$comment: Weekly bosses outside domains (Andrius), keyed by the lowest-id material of their trio; per World Level.
